document.id: Pueblo de San Ildefonso Council Res. No. SI-R26-010
document.heading: PUEBLO DE SAN ILDEFONSO COUNCIL RESOLUTION NO. SI-R26-010
First Amendment to the San Ildefonso Services, LLC Member's Representatives Compensation Act of 2019
document.preamble: At a duly called meeting of the Council of San Ildefonso Pueblo on the 25th day of June, 2026, the following resolution was adopted:

recital.text: the Pueblo de San Ildefonso ("Pueblo") is a sovereign and self-governing Tribe; recognized as such by the United States of America; and,

pursuant to the Fifth Amended Articles of Organization ("Articles"), San Ildefonso Services, LLC ("SIS") purpose is to engage in federal contracting and other lawful business ventures that serve the business interest of SIS and the Pueblo; and,
in accordance with Article X of the Articles, SIS is governed by a Board of Directors comprised of five Members, called "Member's Representatives"; and,
the Member's Representatives shall possess the level of professional experience and expertise determined by the Governor and the Council; and,
Article X(A) of the Articles provides that the "Member's Representatives shall receive compensation at the sole discretion of the Council by law"; and,
pursuant to Tribal Council Resolution No. SI-R20-019, the Member's Representatives currently receive three hundred seventy-five dollars ($375.00) per meeting; and,
SIS and the Pueblo benefit from experienced and well-compensated qualified Members' Representatives to help develop and manage successful business ventures; and,

it is recommended that the Member's Representatives' compensation be capped at seven hundred and fifty dollars ($750.00) per month to align with the industry standard for board member compensation of this kind; and,
SIS will include the Member's Representatives' compensation in its annual budget.
that the Council hereby enacts the attached resolution entitled the "AMENDMENT TO THE SAN ILDEFONSO SERVICES, LLC MEMBER'S REPRESENTATIVES COMPENSATION ACT OF 2019."

procedural-data.text: The foregoing resolution was duly voted upon by the Council on June 25, 2026, at a meeting with a vote of 5 in favor, 0 opposed, 2 abstaining and 3 absent (Governor presiding and not voting) pursuant to the authority vested in the Council by the Agreement of the Pueblo de San Ildefonso.

text.strong: DELIVERY OF THE RESOLUTION TO THE GOVERNOR:

procedural-data.text: Resolution No. SI-R26-010 was presented to the Governor of the Pueblo de San Ildefonso on the

attachment.heading: FIRST AMENDMENT TO THE SAN ILDEFONSO SERVICES, LLC MEMBER'S REPRESENTATIVES COMPENSATION ACT OF 2019

section.heading: Short Title
section.text: This enactment shall be known as the "First Amendment to the San Ildefonso Services, LLC Members' Representatives Compensation Act of 2019" ("Amendment").

section.heading: Purpose
section.text: The purpose of this Amendment is to increase the rate of compensation for the five SIS Members serving as the Members' Representatives.

section.heading: Findings
section.text: The Council hereby finds and declares that:

para.text: Pursuant to the Fifth Amended Articles of Organization ("Articles"), San Ildefonso Services, LLC ("SIS") purpose is to engage in federal contracting and other lawful business ventures that serve the business interest of SIS and the Pueblo; and,
In accordance with Article X of the Articles, SIS is governed by a Board of Directors comprised of five Members, called "Member's Representatives"; and,
The Member's Representatives shall possess the level of professional experience and expertise determined by the Governor and the Council; and,
Article X(A) of the Articles provides that the "Member's Representatives shall receive compensation at the sole discretion of the Council by law"; and,
Pursuant to Tribal Council Resolution No. SI-R20-019, the Member's Representatives currently receive three hundred seventy-five dollars ($375.00) per meeting; and,
SIS and the Pueblo benefit from experienced and well-compensated qualified Member's Representatives to help develop and manage successful business ventures; and,

The Member's Representative's compensation being capped at seven hundred and fifty dollars ($750.00) per month is necessary to align with the industry standard for board member compensation of this kind.

section.heading: Authorization of Amendment
section.text: The Council hereby amends Section 17.2.21.040 of the Member's Representatives Compensation Act of 2019 to authorize an increase in the rate of compensation for each SIS Member's Representative from two hundred and fifty dollars ($250.00) per month to seven hundred and fifty dollars ($750.00) per month and to include it in SIS' annual budget.

section.heading: Establishment of the Rate of Compensation
section.text: The Council hereby establishes the rate of compensation for each SIS Member Representative at seven-hundred fifty dollars ($750.00) per month which will be covered by the San Ildefonso Services, LLC annual budget.
